transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start off, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Uh, hey. Yeah, just... having some trouble at work lately. Like, I'll be in a safety briefing or trying to get through a plan review, and I really try to pay attention. But a few minutes in, my mind is already off on, I don't know, three other problems on the site. I end up missing things I know I should've caught. So... that's why I'm here.
Has this trouble concentrating been something you've noticed since you were a kid, or is this a change that started more recently?

Yeah... it's not a new thing. It's, uh, been going on since I was a kid. 

Even back in elementary school, my teachers were already getting on my parents about it. They'd say I couldn't stay in my seat, or I talked out of turn too much. I was always losing my homework... or I'd just rush through the directions on things before I even understood what I was supposed to be doing. So... yeah. I guess it's always been like this.
Besides at work, do you notice this same restlessness or trouble focusing in other areas of your life, like at home or in social situations?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... at home, it's pretty much the same. My wife, she's... she's getting pretty tired of it. I'll say I'm gonna handle something around the house, and then I just... don't. She has to keep reminding me, which isn't fair to her. And work... yeah, it's bad. I've missed enough follow-ups and messed up the site coordination enough that my boss actually sat me down about it. So... it's definitely an issue everywhere.
Do you also notice yourself feeling physically restless, fidgety, or acting impulsively—like interrupting others or making quick decisions without thinking them through—in your daily life?

Yeah... I guess I do that. The interrupting part, anyway. 

Like at the site, if... if a couple of the subs are talking, or someone's trying to get through some paperwork, I'll just... walk up and jump right in with whatever my point is. Before anyone even asks me. It, uh... it rubs people the wrong way. So... yeah. I do that.
Do you often feel physically restless, like needing to get up and move around, fidget with your hands, or feeling like you can't sit still for long periods, such as during meetings or at home?

Yeah, I guess. I mean... sitting still isn't really my thing. 

Like, if we have a site meeting or whatever, and everyone else is just sitting there the whole time... I can't really do that. I'm usually the guy getting up. I'll, uh, get up to grab coffee, or step outside to check on something. Just... find a reason to move. So, yeah. Sitting for a long time doesn't work so well.
